# Regent Reveals Brand-New Dining Venue Solmar Terrace On Board Seven Seas Prestige™


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_69a6fb96a5c87df41088a63b080acc16/nclhltd/news/2026-09-15_Regent_Reveals_Brand_New_Dining_Venue_Solmar_825.pdf) September 15, 2026 10:00am EDT


***Ultra-Luxury Cruise Line Also Unveils New Mediterranean-Inspired Azure Menu and Refreshes Prime 7 Classics Ahead of Seven Seas Prestige’s Debut this December***


****Solmar Terrace aboard Seven Seas Prestige****


**MIAMI, September 15, 2026** :[Regent Seven Seas Cruises®](https://www.rssc.com/) , the world’s leading ultra-luxury cruise line, has introduced the latest expression of *Epicurean PerfectionTM* aboard[Seven Seas Prestige](https://www.rssc.com/ships/seven_seas_prestige) , announcing the brand-new daytime dining venue: *Solmar Terrace* . Regent has also revealed the menu for its new specialty restaurant *Azure* , alongside enhancements to the beloved *Prime 7* menu, further enriching the all-inclusive culinary experience that awaits guests aboard *Seven Seas Prestige.*


Further elevating the dining experience aboard *Seven Seas Prestige* , *Solmar Terrace at Compass Rose,* is a new al fresco venue exclusive to the ship. Located aft of *Compass Rose* on deck 5 and open from 12:00 to 6:00 PM, the restaurant blends relaxed elegance with globally inspired flavors, inviting guests to enjoy leisurely daytime dining alongside sweeping ocean vistas.


Featuring a wide array of dishes from mezze-style appetizers and sushi to tapas and yakitori, the daytime menu caters to a variety of tastes and moods - from fresh gazpacho and the sushi roll of the day to the varied yakitori grill menu. Asian-inspired small plates include succulent Korean beef short rib, chicken or shrimp satay, teriyaki pork belly, indulgent king oyster mushroom, and Japanese broiled salmon. Finishing the meal with something sweet, guests can delight in decadent desserts such as tres leches cake or luscious crema Catalana.


“Dining is an essential part of the Regent experience, and *Seven Seas Prestige* represents an exciting opportunity to further elevate our all-inclusive culinary offering,” said Wesley D'Silva, president of Regent Seven Seas Cruises. “As the first new Regent ship class in more than a decade, *Seven Seas Prestige* ushers in a new era for our brand, with extraordinary new experiences throughout the ship. *Solmar Terrace at Compass Rose* and *Azure* add even more choice, variety and flexibility for guests, complementing Regent's collection of included specialty restaurants and further enriching the unrivaled ultra-luxury experience that defines a Regent voyage.”


**A First Look at Azure's Mediterranean-Inspired Menu**


One of seven specialty restaurants and 11 dining experiences, *Solmar Terrace* will join the previously announced *Azure* as the second new culinary venue debuting on Regent’s new ship class.


Inspired by the vibrant flavors, spices and culinary traditions of the Mediterranean, *Azure's* newly revealed mezze-style menu draws influences from Europe, Africa and Asia. Designed for sharing, the restaurant celebrates connection and discovery through an array of inventive small plates.


- Miso-Roasted Eggplant
- Croquetas di Carne, served with Piquillo Peppers
- Gambas al Ajillo, Spanish Style Shrimp with Chili, Garlic, and Olive Oil
- Chilled & Spiced Watermelon-Feta Salad
- Lobster Orzo Saganaki
- Duck Leg Confit


**Prime 7 Perfected**


Further elevating Regent’s renowned standard of *Epicurean Perfection* , the menu for *Prime 7* , the line’s beloved specialty steakhouse restaurant, will be enhanced with fresh updates on classic recipes. Regent’s culinary teams have carefully crafted these transformed recipes, drawing inspiration from acclaimed steakhouses, including *Daniel's* in Miami.


Newly inspired and reimagined dishes in *Prime 7* will include:


- House-Smoked & Honey-Roasted Baby Back Ribs, Steakhouse Barbecue Sauce
- Lobster Thermidor
- Halibut Fish & Chips, served with Hot Yuzu Aioli and Steak Fries
- Roasted Chicken Supreme, Spinach-Porcini Stuffing
- Hashbrown Tempura with Lime-Chili Salt
- Truffle Mac & Cheese
- Lemon Meringue Pie
- The Ultimate Chocolate Dessert, 14-Layer Chocolate Mousse Cake with Drunken Cherries
- Double Chocolate Brownie with Tres Leches Ice Cream


Prime 7 recipes will debut on board *Seven Seas Prestige* before rolling out across *The World’s Most Luxurious Fleet®* at a later date. Guests can follow the inspirational journey[here](https://youtu.be/JGO67YiRdAQ) .


Offering Regent guests the chance to indulge in *Epicurean Perfection* like never before, *Seven Seas Prestige* provides a[curated culinary journey across 11 dining experiences](https://www.rssc.com/news/details?newsid=321633) . Alongside the new *Azure* and *Solmar Terrace* , guests can enjoy signature favorites including *Compass Rose* , *Prime 7* , *Pacific Rim* , *Chartreuse* , *Sette Mari at La Veranda* and *La Veranda* , as well as casual venues such as *Pool Grill* and *Coffee Connection* , plus the convenience of 24-hour in-suite dining.


For more information about *Seven Seas Prestige* or to book a voyage, please visit[RSSC.com/Ships/Seven_Seas_Prestige](http://rssc.com/Ships/Seven_Seas_Prestige) , call 1-844-4REGENT (1-844-473-4368) or contact a professional Travel Advisor.


**ENDS**


***About Seven Seas Prestige™ – A New Legacy Begins***


As Regent Seven Seas Cruises’ first new ship-class for a decade, *Seven Seas Prestige* will be 40 percent larger than previous Regent ships, yet accommodates only 10 percent more guests, delivering truly *Unrivaled Space at Sea®* . At 76,550 gross tons with just 411 suites and 630 dedicated crew members, the ship offers one of the highest space-to-guest and crew-to-guest ratios in the cruise industry.


Beautifully appointed all-balcony suites usher in a new era of ultra-luxury accommodation with 12 distinctive categories, featuring four all-new suite types, including the largest all-inclusive, ultra-luxury cruise ship suite in history: the Skyview Regent Suite. Elegant public spaces are thoughtfully designed from the sophisticated, light-filled Starlight Atrium to the art-inspired Galileo’s Bar.


Offering Regent guests the chance to indulge in *Epicurean Perfection* like never before, *Seven Seas Prestige* provides a curated culinary journey across 11 dining experiences. These include Azure and Solmar Terrace, signature favorites Compass Rose, Prime 7, Pacific Rim, Chartreuse, Sette Mari at La Veranda and La Veranda, as well as casual venues such as Pool Grill and Coffee Connection, plus 24-hour in-suite dining.


*Seven Seas Prestige’s* inaugural season will explore iconic destinations across the Caribbean and Europe with 13 immersive voyages. Her maiden sailing departs December 13, 2026, on a festive 14-night transatlantic journey from Barcelona to Miami. From there, guests can discover the sun-soaked charm of the Eastern and Western Caribbean, and the marvels of the Panama Canal, with embarkation ports in Miami, Florida; Los Angeles, California; and New York. The season culminates with elegant sailings along the Iberian Peninsula and the coast of France, including multiple overnight stays. With up to 97 included shore excursions per voyage and calls to boutique ports such as St. Lucia, Cartagena, and Bordeaux, the season offers the perfect blend of vibrant exploration and all-inclusive indulgence.


***About Regent Seven Seas Cruises®***


Regent Seven Seas Cruises® is the world’s leading ultra-luxury cruise line, inviting guests to Experience the Unrivaled® since 1992. With a maximum of only 411 suites, the line’s perfectly-sized ships - *Seven Seas Explorer®* , *Seven Seas Grandeur* ®, *Seven Seas Mariner* ®, *Seven Seas Navigator* ®, *Seven Seas Splendor* ®, *Seven Seas Voyager* ®, and *Seven Seas Prestige* ™, which is scheduled to be delivered in 2026 - form The World’s Most Luxurious Fleet®. Offering immersive exploration in more than 550 destinations across seven continents, guests travel the world in luxurious space featuring sumptuous all-suite accommodations, nearly all with private balconies, which are among the largest at sea. Regent’s heartfelt personalized service can be found throughout lavish public areas and expansive outdoor spaces, or while savoring incomparable culinary experiences in a range of specialty restaurants and al-fresco dining venues. Guests Cruise In All-Inclusive, Unrivaled Luxury™ as part of Regent’s All-Inclusive Cruise Fares, offering amenities such as unlimited shore excursions, exquisite cuisine, beverages including fine wines and spirits, entertainment, Starlink Wi-Fi, valet laundry, gratuities, a one-night, pre-cruise hotel package for guests staying in Concierge-level suites and higher, and more. For more information, please visit RSSC.com, call 1-844-4REGENT (1-844-473-4368) or contact a professional travel advisor. Regent Seven Seas Cruises has four Prestige Class ships on order scheduled for delivery in 2026, 2030, 2033, and 2036. Regent Seven Seas Cruises® is a wholly owned subsidiary of Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: NCLH). To learn more, visit[www.nclhltd.com](http://www.nclhltd.com/) .
